title: Startup ValidationError echoes credential values to stderr
repro: env -i MAGICHOUR_API_KEY=mhk_live_X python -c 'Settings(_env_file=None)' -> input_value dict contains the raw key
guard: assert str(ValidationError) contains no planted secret when a required variable is missing

title: pydantic.mypy plugin disabled constructor argument type checking tree-wide
repro: mypy on a probe module: 6 arg-type errors without the plugin, 1 with it; init_typed=true restores all and the tree still passes
guard: probe module asserting mypy rejects a wrongly typed BaseModel constructor argument

title: Alias-guard allow-list widened to the whole src/video_agent/config package
repro: is_allowlisted('src/video_agent/config/anything.py') is True; AGENT.md S2 line 113 forbids adding an exclusion
guard: pin ALLOWLISTED_PATHS tuple contents exactly, not five sample paths

title: DATABASE_URL and REDIS_URL carry embedded passwords but are typed plain str
guard: extend the credential rule from name suffix to DSN shape

title: Wheel-baked config/aliases.yaml silently shadows an operator-mounted one
repro: installed wheel + ./config/aliases.yaml in cwd -> resolves site-packages copy, operator edit ignored, nothing logged
guard: cwd/explicit path must win over the packaged fallback; log the resolved path

title: Defaults contract test skips every variable declared empty in .env.example
repro: mutation ARTIFACT_ENDPOINT_URL default '' -> 'http://minio:9000' left the suite green
guard: drop the `if declared` truthiness filter for non-SecretStr fields

title: ModelPrice cannot express tiered or per-modality pricing; realtime-voice priced at text rates
repro: openai/gpt-4o-realtime-preview priced 0.005/0.020 which are its text rates, not its audio rates
guard: price the modality the alias actually uses, or raise the ceiling for multi-modal models

title: Presigned URL / DSN emitted verbatim when preceded by a non-whitespace character
repro: log.info('url=%s', presigned) or extra={'reason': 'GET <'+url+'> gave 403'} -> full X-Amz-Signature in the sink, tripwire silent
guard: detectors must search within the string, not only whole-string and whitespace tokens

title: Credential inside a larger token (any object repr/str) is neither name- nor shape-detected
repro: log.info('config %r', cfg) where repr(cfg)=="Cfg(api_key='sk-proj-...')" -> key emitted verbatim
guard: scan for issuer prefixes and secret shapes as substrings, not startswith on a whitespace token

title: prompt_preview allow-listed as free TEXT bypasses the 64-character prompt window
repro: extra={'prompt_preview': 975 chars of PII} -> all 975 emitted; observability.md §5 permits 64
guard: give prompt_preview its own FieldKind capped at PROMPT_PREVIEW_CHARS

title: Bootstrap exemption covers sys.stdout.write, contrary to its own docstring, and its contents are unpinned
repro: adding sys.stdout.write('noise') to src/video_agent/__main__.py leaves all 452 tests green; adding a second path to the tuple also leaves them green
guard: restrict the exemption to the stderr attribute and assert the tuple by equality

title: configure_logging has no caller; unconfigured get_logger falls through to logging.lastResort unredacted
repro: get_logger('x').warning('uploading to %s', presigned) with nothing configured -> plain-text stderr, no trace_id, no redaction
guard: fail loudly or lazily install when the substrate has not been configured

title: ISO-BMFF fallback in _has_media_magic is unexercised despite 100% branch coverage
repro: replacing the ISO-BMFF return with False leaves all 452 tests green; only ftyp box length 0x18 is literal-matched
guard: test an MP4 whose ftyp box length is not 0x18

title: find_unstructured_loggers misses `import logging.handlers` followed by logging.getLogger
repro: module with `import logging.handlers` then `logging.getLogger(__name__)` is not flagged
guard: treat any dotted import whose root is `logging` as binding the name `logging`
